item.description:
Toucan 1.0.11

  • On a client’s Structure page, clicking a name now opens its editor straight away even when you’ve scrolled down past the top of the list. Before, it could fail to open until you scrolled back up.

Toucan 1.0.10

  • Adding a name from a client’s Structure page is quicker: type it in the search box, and if it isn’t there, choose Add… › Add to Replace… or Add to Keep…. The name you typed is already filled in.
  • In Add to Replace, Toucan also picks a category from the name’s words (Ltd as ENTITY, Trust as TRUST, Bank as BANK) and suggests the usual ways it’s written as aliases, ready to tick. You can still change either before adding.

Toucan 1.0.9

  • Relationships on a client’s Structure page read as sentences: Jane Example is Parent of John Example, or Example Family Trust has Trustee Jane Example. Choose a role from the menu and Toucan adds the small word (of, to, for) itself. Adding a link reads the same way.
  • Fewer relationship words to choose from, 14 instead of 22. Daughter of and Son of are now Child of, and a parent can now be added from the parent’s own entry too. Shareholder of, Partner in and Member of are now Owner, with a percentage as before. Relationship manager for and Investment manager for are now Adviser to. Portfolio for is now Account for.
  • Links you’ve already added change to the new words by themselves, nothing is lost. Where two links to the same entry become one, their percentages are added together; if that comes to more than 100%, the link is kept at 100% and marked to confirm, so it shows under Issues.
  • The Entity Map expands within Toucan’s window: click Expand on the map, or press ⇧⌘M, and it fills the page beside the sidebar. Click Collapse or press Esc to go back. The separate Entity Map window has gone.
  • Long names on a relationship line are shortened with “…” so percentages always fit; point at a name to see it in full.
